# Data dictionary

*Generated by `scripts/data_dictionary.py` from `data/serving/atlas.duckdb`, the dbt YAML and the metric layer. Do not edit by hand. Row counts are for the flagship build (Halden seed 20261023; GA4 extract of 2026-10-23).*

The workspaces are never joined. Every table belongs to exactly one of them.

## Metrics

| Workspace | Metric | Definition | Formula | Grain | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| halden | **Revenue** (`revenue`) | Recorded first-order plus repeat revenue, net of promotional discounts. | `sum(revenue)` | week × region | Simulated |
| halden | **New-customer revenue** (`first_order_revenue`) | Revenue from customers' first orders in the period. | `sum(first_order_revenue)` | week × region | Simulated |
| halden | **Returning-customer revenue** (`repeat_revenue`) | Revenue from repeat orders by previously acquired customers. | `sum(repeat_revenue)` | week × region | Simulated |
| halden | **New-customer revenue share** (`new_customer_revenue_share`) | First-order revenue / total revenue. | `first_order_revenue / revenue` |  | Simulated |
| halden | **Paid media spend** (`spend`) | Billed spend across the six paid channels. | `sum(spend)` | week × region × channel | Simulated |
| halden | **First-order contribution** (`first_order_contribution`) | First-order revenue minus product cost, fulfilment and promotional discount. | `sum(first_order_contribution)` | week × region | Simulated |
| halden | **Repeat contribution** (`repeat_contribution`) | Contribution margin on repeat orders. | `sum(repeat_contribution)` | week × region | Simulated |
| halden | **Contribution profit** (`contribution_profit`) | First-order contribution + repeat contribution − paid media spend. | `sum(first_order_contribution + repeat_contribution - spend)` | week × region | Simulated |
| halden | **MER (marketing efficiency ratio)** (`mer`) | Total revenue / total paid spend. Blended; says nothing about incrementality. | `revenue / spend` |  | Simulated |
| halden | **New customers** (`new_customers`) | Recorded first-time purchasers. | `sum(new_customers)` | week × region | Simulated |
| halden | **Orders** (`orders`) | Recorded first and repeat orders. | `sum(orders)` | week × region | Simulated |
| halden | **Site sessions** (`sessions`) | Paid sessions (platform clicks) plus organic/direct sessions. | `sum(sessions)` | week × region | Simulated |
| halden | **Conversion rate** (`conversion_rate`) | Orders / sessions. | `orders / sessions` |  | Simulated |
| halden | **Average order value** (`aov`) | Revenue / orders. | `revenue / orders` |  | Simulated |
| halden | **Blended CAC** (`blended_cac`) | Total paid spend / all new customers (paid and organic). | `spend / new_customers` |  | Simulated |
| halden | **Last-click conversions** (`last_click_conversions`) | New customers whose last tracked touch was the channel. | `sum(last_click_conversions)` | week × region × channel | Attributed |
| halden | **Last-click revenue** (`last_click_revenue`) | First-order revenue of last-click-credited new customers. | `sum(last_click_revenue)` | week × region × channel | Attributed |
| halden | **Last-click ROAS** (`last_click_roas`) | Last-click first-order revenue / billed spend. | `last_click_revenue / spend` |  | Attributed |
| halden | **Paid CAC (last-click)** (`paid_cac_attributed`) | Billed spend / last-click new customers. | `spend / last_click_conversions` |  | Attributed |
| halden | **Clicks** (`clicks`) | Platform-reported clicks. | `sum(clicks)` | week × region × channel | Simulated |
| halden | **Impressions** (`impressions`) | Platform-reported impressions. | `sum(impressions)` | week × region × channel | Simulated |
| halden | **Cost per click** (`cpc`) | Billed spend / clicks. | `spend / clicks` |  | Simulated |
| halden | **Click-through rate** (`ctr`) | Clicks / impressions. | `clicks / impressions` |  | Simulated |
| halden | **First-order contribution margin rate** (`first_order_cm_rate`) | First-order contribution / first-order revenue. Default margin assumption for the optimizer. | `first_order_contribution / first_order_revenue` |  | Simulated |
| halden | **Estimated 52-week revenue per new customer** (`est_value_52w_per_new_customer`) | ESTIMATE. Trailing-52-week (first-order + repeat revenue) / new customers in the same 52 weeks. A steady-state approximation of 52-week value; ignores the start of the requested date range. | `None / None (trailing 52 weeks)` |  | Modeled |
| halden | **Repeat-value multiplier (52 weeks)** (`repeat_value_multiplier`) | ESTIMATE. Trailing-52-week repeat contribution / first-order contribution. Used as the default 52-week multiplier assumption in the optimizer (52-week contribution = first-order contribution × (1 + multiplier)). | `None / None (trailing 52 weeks)` |  | Modeled |
